checks.name: raw_not_empty
checks.why: A failed or empty download must stop the pipeline, not publish an empty mart.

checks.name: raw_not_truncated
checks.why: Sales history only grows. A snapshot with >10% fewer rows than the previous one is almost certainly a truncated export.

checks.name: sale_date_parsed
checks.why: Dataset-specific: the data dictionary documents dd/mm/yyyy, but the export uses ISO dates. Any value that matches neither silently becomes NULL, so this fails if the format drifts.

checks.name: parcel_id_present
checks.why: A sale without a parcel cannot be attributed to a property or municipality.

checks.name: parcel_id_format
checks.why: The dictionary says PARID is 16 characters. Other lengths suggest truncation or a different ID scheme.

checks.name: price_not_negative
checks.why: A negative consideration is never valid.

checks.name: sale_date_not_in_future
checks.why: Sales cannot occur after the data was published.

checks.name: recorded_before_sale
checks.why: Deeds are recorded after the sale. Recording more than 30 days earlier points to a data entry error.

checks.name: sale_id_unique
checks.why: The fact table grain is one row per parcel sale. Duplicates would double count.

checks.name: market_sales_have_real_price
checks.why: Guards the market-sale rule: $0 and $1 transfers must never reach price statistics.

checks.name: multi_parcel_deeds_excluded
checks.why: Dataset-specific: one deed can cover several parcels with the full price repeated on each row. No deed may contribute more than one market sale.

checks.name: multi_parcel_price_is_repeated
checks.why: Dataset-specific: verifies the assumption above. If parcels on one deed carry different prices, the price may be split rather than repeated, and the exclusion rule should be revisited.

checks.name: mart_grain_unique
checks.why: The mart must have exactly one row per municipality per year.

checks.name: mart_quantiles_ordered
checks.why: p25 <= median <= p75 must always hold; otherwise the aggregation is wrong.

checks.name: mart_market_le_recorded
checks.why: Market sales are a subset of recorded transfers.

checks.name: dates_have_plausible_year
checks.why: Dataset-specific: a record date with the year 212 parsed as a valid date, so the parse check missed it. Dates before 1900 are data entry errors. A small known number is tolerated; a jump means a systemic problem.
